title: Link Manager
intro: Short markaztadarus.com links that lead to any form, folder, video, or page.

legacy.title: {{count}} older links are not here yet
legacy.text: These links still live in the site's code. Import them so they can be edited, paused, and counted — their addresses stay the same.

search: Search links, titles, destinations, or notes…

empty.title: No links yet

deleteConfirm: Delete {{path}}? Anyone who opens it will see a "link not found" page.

editor.notePlaceholder: What the link is for, who uses it…

editor.endsHint: Optional. Handy for forms with a deadline.

errors.badPath: A short link may only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

errors.badUrl: The destination must be a web address, e.g. https://docs.google.com/…
errors.loopUrl: The destination cannot point back to this same short link.
errors.failed: Could not save. Please try again.

qr.title: QR code
qr.hint: Print-ready, with the logo in the middle and the address underneath. It keeps working even if the destination changes.
